decisions.reason: Underground LHD loaders sit at the core of the firm's underground engineering and service know-how, so it can keep learning from field results and improving the line rather than abandoning it.

Underground dump trucks share components, safety systems and customers with the loaders, giving the firm the related knowledge to refine them, though their absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 adds some uncertainty.

The construction site dumper builds on the firm's vehicle and drivetrain expertise, but it was only mentioned on the website and serves a more competitive market where the firm has less specific application knowledge.
The inclined furniture lift is a multi-model line with its own page within the firm's stated lifting business, so it draws on established lifting engineering and service capabilities.
The inclined building material lift shares its design base and construction customers with the furniture lifts, so the firm can assimilate user feedback and keep improving it.
The truck-mounted variant combines the firm's lifting and vehicle know-how, but as a single niche model it carries somewhat more risk of being folded into the main lift range.
